en: {player}! The Champion of Hoenn at last, and I was here to see it. Didn't I say I'd be cheering?
I told you I was looking for trainers who could carry on what the Battle Frontier stands for. Here, take this.
The Frontier is where the strongest Trainers of every region meet. Five halls, five Frontier Brains, and a place for you.
My ferry runs to the Battle Frontier whenever you like. Your team goes along, and the Frontier keeps one record of your streaks and Battle Points.
Shall we sail for the Battle Frontier now?
Wonderful! Hold on to your hat.
{player} sailed with Scott for the Battle Frontier...
No hurry. The Frontier will still be there when you are ready.
